weekly_priority.text: I'm watching Matthew execute with precision: 43 logged training sessions in 30 days, zero missed zone-2 workouts, and a consistent 1,500-calorie eating window across 21 food-logged days. His weight has dropped 12.8 pounds over three weeks—aggressive and intentional—and his recovery score is holding steady at 89%. On day 23 of the Foundation phase, the structural work is solid. The one priority I've asked him to address next is his protein intake, currently averaging 153.5 grams across logged days against a 170-gram floor. This isn't about motivation; it's about convenience. By locking one meal into a deliberate, low-friction protein choice, he can close this gap and protect lean mass as the caloric deficit compounds through the remaining 11 months.
